permutation_construction: a cyclic permutation group of order B + 1 per replicate: o = PCG64(50000000 + replicate_index).permutation(n) is cut, in order, into floor(n / (B + 1)) cycles of length B + 1 followed by cycles whose lengths divide B + 1 (largest divisor first) covering the remainder; sigma maps each element of a cycle to the next one (sigma[c] = roll(c, -1)); permuted arm b = 0 .. B-1 uses labels[sigma^(b+1)], where sigma^(B+1) is the identity, so {id, sigma, ..., sigma^B} is a group and the observed assignment is its identity element; global class counts are preserved exactly

probe.convergence: a fit converges when n_iter_ < max_iter, no ConvergenceWarning is raised and the maximum absolute gradient of the training objective at the fitted parameters, computed independently of scikit-learn, is at most gradient_tolerance
probe.max_iter_rule: max_iter = 2000 unless the blinded benchmark records a non-converged fit at 2000 and every fit converges at 5000, in which case 5000; no other value and no retry
probe.non_convergence: the replicate is FAILED; nothing is retried or changed
probe.objective: mean multinomial (or binary) log-loss over the training fold plus ||W||^2 / (2 C n_train); the intercept is not penalised

published_accuracy_source: autond_ce1/AutoND-upstream/README.md lines 151-181 at the pinned upstream commit: eval_nets.py on the polished round-8 SPECK32/64 checkpoint, 5 evaluation sets of 10^6 samples from main.make_train_data (label Y ~ Bernoulli(1/2), Y = 0 inputs uniform), metric accuracy of 1[score > 0.5] (eval_nets.py evaluate_X_Y), reported as mean 0.5144 +- 0.0003 (standard deviation over the 5 sets); the per-set TPR 0.512-0.514 and TNR 0.515-0.517 make the balanced accuracy equal to the accuracy to the reported precision

reference_scenario.C: calibration means and covariance of (probe BA, twin BA, model BA) estimated from the same replications, with the synthetic model's sign-rule accuracy set to 0.5144 in each replication's own geometry and the calibration size fixed at the design's 50000 per class for every n
reference_scenario.S1_S2: the synthetic target carries a population oracle balanced-accuracy effect of SESOI; the twin and the permuted arms carry none; the probe-level means, variances and covariances of BA(A), BA(T) and BA(P_b) are estimated from the independent synthetic replications at each n, so the n-dependent estimation loss is included

report: AutoND CE3 power after the S1 rank correction: pipeline-faithful replications, parameter uncertainty and sensitivity

s1_null_check.method: pipeline-faithful null: the class labels carry no signal (independent of the representation), the CE3 probe, permutation group and tie-break are run unchanged; under the null the upper-half fraction is exactly 1/2 and every rank has probability 1/(B + 1)

s1_procedure: R - (B + 2) / 2, where R in {1, ..., B + 1} is the rank of the observed assignment among the B + 1 group assignments when they are ordered by (exact rational BA, recorded tie-break value), ascending; S1 > 0 exactly when R is one of the upper (B + 1) / 2 ranks (R >= 4 for B = 5); S1 is never 0

selection.b_rule: B odd, so that B + 1 assignments split into two equal halves of ranks; the smallest B in {5, 11, 21} whose planning P(SUPPORTED) at the reference scenario is within 0.01 of B = 21 and whose uncertainty-propagated lower bound still meets the n rule
selection.lower_bound: 0.05 quantile of the bootstrap distribution of P(SUPPORTED)
selection.n_rule: the smallest n in {50000, 100000, 200000} whose uncertainty-propagated lower bound for P(SUPPORTED) (5th percentile over the bootstrap distribution of the synthetic pipeline parameters, evaluated with B = 21) is at least 0.90 at the reference scenario of the power evidence; if none qualifies the design is not frozen

synthetic_model: 64 ReLU features relu(G M) with Gaussian G and a random mixing matrix M drawn per replication; the target class is an ordinal coarsening of a noisy linear score of the features with the P1 class fractions; the twin is an independent signal-free ReLU representation; the calibration labels follow a logistic model in a linear score whose sign rule reaches the published accuracy; the CE3 fold, permutation group, tie-break, probe and exact balanced-accuracy code is run unchanged
zero_policy: an endpoint exactly 0.0 (including -0.0) is a non-positive outcome: it stays in the denominator and counts against rejection; no zero is ever removed. S1 cannot be 0
